decision: Approve the transient-feedback-reset-key convention (resetKey) for declaratively clearing transient feedback without changing the component value or remounting.

userStatements.provenance: odd/tasks/attachment-field-reset-key.md L2 (2026-11-20): approval of the AttachmentField v0.2 amendment and transient-feedback-reset-key convention in docs/components/attachment-field/v0.2/reset-key-amendment.md section 2

limits: Binds only the transient-feedback-reset-key convention payload below; existing conventions and their approvals remain unchanged.
The token resets transient feedback, not the component value or React identity; no migration or callback is implied.

convention.name: resetKey
convention.meaning: Consumer token changes reset component-defined transient feedback without changing its value or remounting.
convention.whenToUse: Use declaratively when a consumer needs to reset transient feedback.
convention.avoid: List resets, React identity keys and callbacks.
